description: Bonsai is about trees, trees grown in miniature. It is also about time and space and about life and attitudes. Historically, Bonsai was a part of the culture, an important part of family heritage. Equally, Bonsai can be simply a horticultural past time requiring no more than a measure of common garden sense, some artistic ability and plenty of patience.  This artificial bonsai tree no need watering, trimming or maintenance is required. With its timeless beauty evoking  a feeling of nature, this center piece accommodates any architectural setting.
